# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. Each entry
is grouped by version and section. The source of truth for any one
release's verbose notes is the merged PR body on GitHub:
https://github.com/ctolon/owui-cee-proxy/releases

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/)
and the project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

This file is regenerated by `git-cliff` on every release; see
`cliff.toml` for the section grouping. Manual edits between releases
will be overwritten.
